name: finance_bench-4096
description: A domain-specific benchmark of long-context finance tasks designed to evaluate language models' ability to understand, reason about, and answer finance-related queries from extended documents (up to 4,096 tokens). Tasks include question answering, long-form reasoning, and summarization over financial documents and discussions. It measures models' capability to retrieve and synthesize relevant information from long financial contexts accurately.
reputation: A niche, domain-focused benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use for evaluating finance-capable LLMs.
